learning_outcomes.description: Apply agile principles and Scrum ceremonies in a multi-developer team setting.
Formulate test cases and execute Test-Driven Development (TDD) using unit and integration test runners.
Refactor legacy systems using SOLID design principles and clean code design patterns.

weeks.topic: Software Lifecycles, Waterfall vs Agile, and Scrum Framework.
Requirements Elicitation, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria.
Version Control Workflows (Git Flow, Trunk-based) and Code Reviews.
Object-Oriented Design Principles (SOLID) and Design Patterns.
Test-Driven Development (TDD), Mocking, and Test Automation.
Midterm Sprint Review and Architecture Defense.
Clean Architecture, Layer Separation, and Domain-Driven Design Basics.
Refactoring Code Smells and Technical Debt Management.
Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), and Automated Deployment.
Final Sprint Retrospective and Production Release.
